articles.title: Syrian Energy Deals Spark Debate Over Sovereign Ownership of New Power Plants
articles.excerpt: Energy specialists note that adopting a BOO model does not automatically diminish state authority. The post Syrian Energy Deals Spark Debate Over Sovereign Ownership of New Power Plants first appeared on The Syrian Observer.
articles.summary: 叙利亚能源领域相关交易引发争论，焦点是新建电站的主权所有权归属问题。能源专家指出，采用BOO（建设—拥有—运营）模式并不必然削弱国家权力。
